reviews.text:
My dog ​​turned three, and I decided to finally get his teeth cleaned, something I'd been meaning to do. Since I often passed by this clinic during walks, I decided to stop in for a consultation.
I was worried about general anesthesia and whether I could avoid going to the vet if I brushed his teeth regularly, but the doctor explained everything thoroughly, and I felt completely at ease entrusting him with the treatment!
They showed me videos of the examination and treatment, and explained the treatment steps, costs, and future teeth-brushing training using written materials. I was very impressed by their attentive service.
I would recommend this clinic to anyone considering dental treatment for their dog!
I'll continue to rely on them to help protect my dog's teeth for years to come.

We received treatment for periodontal disease in our 17-year-old senior cat.

We were very worried about general anesthesia due to her age, but the thorough pre-operative examination and detailed explanation of the results allowed us to address our anxieties one by one before the surgery.

After the surgery, we were shown a video of the procedure and given a clear explanation of every step taken. Their open and transparent approach to explaining the treatment was very reassuring.

Given her age, we were very anxious about the surgery, but the careful attention we received from the initial examination to post-operative care made us truly glad we chose this clinic.

Not only the doctor, but all the staff were calm and kind, and they listened attentively to our concerns and questions. We felt completely at ease every time we visited the hospital.

I would recommend this hospital to anyone worried about dental treatment or general anesthesia for elderly pets.

Thank you so much for everything!

Thank you so much for your help!

My 20-year-old cat was experiencing mouth pain and had stopped eating well, so I took her in for a checkup, and she underwent tooth extraction surgery.

The pre-operative examination was thorough, and the surgery was performed as a last chance for her to be anesthetized.

The doctor carefully determined which teeth could be saved and which needed to be extracted using X-rays, and performed an effective surgery with minimal stress on her body.

The explanation I received when I picked her up was very thorough, with videos and X-rays, which put my mind at ease.

Yesterday, I took her in for a follow-up examination one week after the surgery, and the doctor said she was recovering well.

She still has some stitches, so she's a little fussy with her mouth, but the bad breath is gone, and she's eating well again.

I imagine surgery on an elderly cat must have been a heavy burden for the doctor (he was truly relieved, haha).

I will cherish her and aim for her to live to 30 years old.

I will also bring my other 20-year-old cat in for a dental checkup sometime soon, so thank you in advance.

We would be grateful for your continued support so that more cat owners can enjoy long and happy lives with their beloved felines.

Thank you so much for everything.

We received excellent care for our 17-year-and-9-month-old Miniature Dachshund's periodontal disease surgery.

Due to her advanced age and high heart rate, she had been refused surgery at nearly five different hospitals over the years. Desperate to help her with her worsening periodontal disease, we called Keikoku Clinic. The staff were incredibly kind and helpful, quickly arranging an appointment so we could see the head veterinarian.

During the initial consultation, they explained her current condition and the surgery in great detail, listening attentively to our anxieties and concerns. We were also very grateful that they were able to complete the examination and tests in one day, especially since we had traveled a long distance.

We were anxious about the surgery due to her advanced age, but thanks to the doctors, it was completed successfully.

When we picked her up, they explained everything carefully, and we were so happy that the head veterinarian, Dr. Nakamori, and all the staff smiled and said, "Sora, you did so well!" The entire hospital was incredibly warm and welcoming, and I truly felt that I had made the right decision in entrusting my dog's care to them.

Above all, I am deeply grateful that they thoroughly examined my dog's condition and made a decision, especially since other hospitals had told me it was difficult.

After the surgery, there were no major abnormalities in the test results, and they provided thoughtful advice on maintaining my dog's health in the future.

I traveled a long distance to visit the hospital three times for dental treatment, and I was so happy that the reception staff remembered my dog's name, Sora-chan, even before I said it.

The hospital, from the head veterinarian to the other doctors and staff, was so kind and warm that I would like to continue having my dog ​​cared for here for the rest of her life.

And of course, the skills and knowledge of the head veterinarians are outstanding.

I am truly glad I chose Keikoku Hospital.

I am deeply grateful.

I had a tooth extraction surgery performed on my 15-year-old Chihuahua. I was concerned about the treatment because of his age and the need for general anesthesia, but the doctor explained everything in detail, and I decided to go ahead with the surgery. I felt very reassured because the doctor called me several times during the surgery to keep me updated on his progress. I wish I had taken him to the hospital sooner. I'm so glad I had the surgery done.

Thank you for your help with my dog's periodontal disease (surgery). I was able to entrust my dog ​​to you with peace of mind because you explained the current situation, treatment plan, and schedule in detail beforehand. Thanks to you, my dog ​​has been healthy ever since. Thank you very much.

My 7-year-old Shih Tzu underwent periodontal surgery.

Her gums were black and swollen, and I was worried it might be a serious illness, so I went to a hospital specializing in dental treatment (oral melanoma) for my first visit.

The result? I highly recommend them!!

I've already recommended them to my friends.

Dr. Nakamori, who performed the surgery, was very thorough and provided excellent informed consent.

The nurses were also very kind, and my dog ​​was relaxed.

I was worried because she also had periodontal disease, but she underwent surgery under general anesthesia. They even showed me a video of the surgery, which made me feel very reassured. I was surprised to learn that she was congenitally missing 3 upper and 8 lower teeth. The biopsy results showed the blackness was due to pigmentation and the swelling was due to gingival hyperplasia, which was a relief.

My next appointment is in six months, and I'll do my best with the care they taught me!!

I'd really like to make them my family vet, but since I have to drive, it's a bit of a dilemma.

I was considering having my beloved dog's teeth extracted, and brought him to this clinic for the first time when he was 15 years old. I was anxious about the surgery because he was a senior dog, but the pre-operative examination was thorough, and mitral valve insufficiency was also discovered. I felt confident entrusting him with the surgery, and afterwards, I also had him groomed here for safety and peace of mind.

Recently, my beloved dog passed away at the age of 16 and a half. Throughout his life, he was always cared for gently and carefully, and I felt at ease entrusting him to this clinic's care, knowing they provided thoughtful attention to his senior years. I am deeply grateful. Thank you.

When my dog's tooth broke and I was in despair, they performed surgery on him even though it was their day off. The explanations were very easy to understand, and the doctor is passionate and trustworthy. He tells me if something is unnecessary, and with each visit, I gain new knowledge, which is very satisfying for me as a pet owner.

I have my beloved cat taken care of here. When I first brought my cat home from Pet Kojima, she wasn't feeling well, and the vet at the pet shop couldn't pinpoint the cause right away. However, the vet here quickly identified the cause as giardia and cured her. Because of that experience, I have a lot of trust in them. I think the other reviews are also very good, and this is a very trustworthy animal hospital. I'm glad there's a place like this within a reasonable distance.
